description: This PHP source file defines the StockStatus class within the Opencart admin localisation module. It manages CRUD operations and data retrieval related to stock statuses in the e-commerce platform, interfacing with a database and cache system.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Represents and manages stock status entries within the Opencart admin localisation module, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving stock statuses and their descriptions from the database.

methods.name: addStockStatus
methods.description: Creates a new stock status in the database based on provided data, and loads associated descriptions for each language.

methods.name: editStockStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing stock status record, replacing its descriptions with new data.

methods.name: deleteStockStatus
methods.description: Removes a stock status record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all stock status records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stock status record by its ID for the current configuration language.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of stock status records, optionally filtered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalStockStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of stock status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a stock status in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all stock status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stock status description for a given stock status ID and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a particular stock status ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all stock status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.
